messages.subject: S1 fix round done
messages.body: Fixed all three Required findings on branch fleet/build-s1 (head af83a56e816cce655524da6e46531178405c6c33), each red-first: slug suffixes now checked against taken slugs (a, a-1, a-1-1, a-2), headings are slugged from plain text with code spans, links, images and emphasis stripped while the visible TOC text stays original, and fences opened on list-item lines are detected. Also fixed both nits: empty headings are no longer rendered as links (they still consume a slug slot) and --max-depth below 1 is a clean argparse error. Full suite is green (python3 -m unittest discover, 28 tests OK); nothing pushed, SPEC.md untouched, and O1 (combining marks) is left for a later slice.
